title: There’s No Mistaking Your ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Fandom With These HUNTR/X Gel Press-On Nails: Shop Here
summary: With prices starting at $6.99, the collection includes gel press-on nails, chrome nail polish representing Rumi, Mira and Zoey and a metallic stick to create the popular "cat-eye" effect.
contentText:

Bring your KPop Demon Hunters fandom to your fingertips with HUNTR/X-inspired nails that make a statement. Ohora’s collection features gel press-ons, magnetic nail care polishes that create velvet or “cat-eye” effects and special sets for fans who want multiple designs in one purchase. Nail options include Midnight Hunter, Aurora Halo, Golden Veil, Crystal Aura and Silk Dancheong, with finishes ranging from pastel marble to natural glow and designs featuring the fictional group’s emblem.

shop full nail collection here

As of this writing, Ohora is running its 2026 Halloween sale , with sets discounted by up to 30%. Fans can shop within their budget by choosing one press-on set or nail polish, pairing products in duos or trios or purchasing the full collection. Whether you want everyday KPop Demon Hunters nail art or a finishing touch for your Halloween costume inspired by the Oscar-winning movie , there are several options to match your look.

GEL PRESS-ONS

Midnight Hunter Gel Press-On Nails

Halloween Sale

Midnight Hunter is one of five gel press-on designs in the collection, alongside Aurora Halo , Golden Veil , Crystal Aura and Silk Dancheong .

To apply, trim your nails, clean each nail with a prep pad to remove oil and moisture, then test the press-on sizes against your nail beds. Apply a thin layer of primer and let it dry before attaching each nail. For removal, apply Ohora’s Green Tea 3-in-1 Nail Remover , then gently lift the press-ons with a cuticle pusher or orange wood stick.

FULL SET

'KPop Demon Hunters' Full Set

$142.99 $197.91 28% off

The full set includes all five gel press-on designs, three magnetic nail care polishes and a magnetic stick .

Priced at $142.99 during the 2026 Halloween sale, the full set offers a way to purchase the collection together rather than buying each item separately. Ohora press-ons can last around 10–14 days, depending on application and wear, so customers are getting at least 10 weeks of nail art in this set. The included magnetic stick works with the magnetic polishes to create dimensional “cat-eye” lines or a soft velvet-like finish.

NAIL POLISH

Rumi Magnetic Purple Nail Care Polish

$15.99 $19.99 20% off

The Rumi Magnetic Purple Nail Care Polish is one of three character-inspired shades, alongside Mira Magnetic Pink and Zoey Magnetic Green .

The polishes can be worn on their own for a chrome finish or paired with the included magnetic stick to create a “cat-eye” or a velvet effect. One detail to note: despite its name, Zoey Magnetic Green is a metallic nude shade with a slight green shine, rather than a true green. Fans can buy the polishes individually or the full set , which includes all three polishes along with all five gel press-ons.

MAGNET

Two-Way Magnetic Stick

$6.99 $9.99 30% off

The magnetic stick shapes the metallic particles in Ohora’s magnetic polishes to create either a defined “cat-eye” stripe or a softer, all-over velvet sheen.

To create the look, apply the polish and work on one nail at a time while the final coat is still wet. Hold the magnet about 2–3 mm above the nail without touching the polish, keeping it steady for 30–60 seconds to develop the pattern. Follow the polish’s specific curing instructions if using a gel formula.
